div.div: Q. 1 كَرْبَحَ He prostrated another: or, [evidently a mistake for and,] inf. n. كَرْبَحَةٌ, he ran heavily; (K;) as also كَرْمَحَ: (TA:) and he ran at a slower pace than that termed كَرْدَحَةٌ, (K,) or كَرْدَمَةٌ, which is a pace of the ass and mule only. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
